She/he will foster collaboration across thematic areas and national and sub-national levels, ensuring timeliness, adequacy, relevance, and quality of programming support to national and sub-national entities.
She/he will act as an analyst/advisor, proactively providing the Deputy Representative and the Representative with information on achievement of results in the implementation of UNFPA programme.
The incumbent ensures strategic advocacy and policy advice at the highest levels for the assigned areas, and will establish, maintain, and foster collaborative relationships with counterparts in government, multi-lateral and bilateral donor agencies and civil society partners, to address emerging issues on population change and other megatrends and to facilitate programme delivery.
Overall, she/he has a triple role of supporting the formulation and delivery of the UNFPA country programme, playing a leadership role to the programme team in the country office while overseeing all functions related to the country programme, including strategic planning and implementation in line with the Country Programme Document and the UNFPA Strategic Plan (2022-2025), and supporting UNFPA’s integration and participation in the Delivering as One modality in Nigeria.

Programme Leadership:
Support country programme design, implementation, monitoring and reporting with appropriate guidance and orientation of implementing partners on effective modalities and practices.
Act as UNFPA liaison with the Government, civil society, and other relevant stakeholders on national priorities; and proactively provides the country office management with timely information to guide CO actions within the national context.

Position Summary:
The analyst will be supporting the Semicolon Ventures team and our portfolio companies, working across all elements of due diligence, research initiatives, investor communications, pipeline management, and portfolio management activities including fund reporting.
The analyst supports the portfolio companies with general finance-related support, including building an economic model for their projects, providing research and information to help make strategic decisions, and ensuring the companies are well managed. For the Semicolon Ventures team, the analyst will perform due diligence on potential companies and their ensuing industries, provide insight into economic trends and evaluate investment potential, assist with portfolio management activities, investor quarterly reports, and venture studio ecosystem-building activities.
You will be part of all Semicolon Ventures activities, with direct exposure to the senior management and our network of companies.

Key Requirements
Have an understanding of financial information, such as financial statements, company accounts, and sector data, as well as wider business information such as relevant economic data and political events.
Be capable of analysing financial information relating to specific companies, e.g. company results, profit and loss, balance sheet, and cash flow statements to determine how an organisation is positioned to deliver for investors.
Be skilled at examining and interpreting data from different sources and exhibit an understanding of the impact this will have on investment and fund management decision-making.
Be skilled at drafting and writing market and industry-specific research reports for the portfolio manager or portfolio companies.
Be skilled at quantitative analysis, building financial models to stress test unit economics, investment projections, and valuation analysis, including discounted cash flows, relative valuations, asset valuations, comparable companies, and transaction multiples.
Be skilled in accounting, project financing, project valuation, and financial statement analysis.
A deep knowledge of Microsoft Office products, especially Microsoft Excel, VBA, PowerPoint, and deep market research and analysis skills.
Principal Responsibilities and Accountabilities
The role will include, but will not be limited to the following areas:
Operational Excellence
Have regular meetings with the fund manager, providing information including summaries of research, investment ideas, and key periodical reports.
Regularly keep up to date with market developments, new investment products, and all other areas that can affect the markets and portfolio companies, e.g. movements in the economies of relevant countries. monitoring the financial news using specialist media sources.
Screen inbound deal-flow and propose new investment targets, conducting due diligence on companies and industries through researching market data and financial statements. This will include doing market sizing and competitor research.
Performing periodical industry landscape evaluations, maintaining and updating industry-specific reports on relevant technology industries, as well as updating the team on all pertinent compliance regulations.
Conduct a review of materials used in the fundraising efforts, including investment memoranda, management presentations, and pitch decks.
Perform periodical valuation reports comparable companies, precedents, and discounted cash flow analysis.
Assist in monitoring the progress of the portfolio companies, participating in meetings with founders, and creating progress update presentations.
Financial Management

Prepare financial models and perform financial analysis of portfolio companies relatively quickly.
Support the fund manager in holding activities such as fund accounting and reporting activities for the board and investor review.
Prepare cost and forecast reports on a regular basis.
Strategic Development

Development of various financial models to support capital-raising efforts and potential partnerships for portfolio companies.
Monitor the venture capital and building ecosystems for industry events, valuations, and other relevant information.
Prepare pitchbooks for client meetings, and support the investment and reporting activities of the ventures fund
